name: localgrid-proxy
description: GitHub Pages (github.io) mirror of localgrid.dev, built from the published @astrelitehq/localgrid npm package at its own base path.

scripts.build: VITE_BASE_PATH=/localgrid.proxy/ npm run build --prefix node_modules/@astrelitehq/localgrid && rm -rf dist && cp -r node_modules/@astrelitehq/localgrid/dist dist
